summary_1line: Ashwatthama devastates Panchala forces; Pandavas counterattack Drona while Satyaki advances to duel Somadatta amid the chaotic battlefield.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ashwatthama stands blazing on his chariot after slaughtering thousands, roaring like thunder while terrified Panchala warriors flee across the blood-soaked field.
Elephants struck by arrows collapse like hills as severed trunks writhe on the ground, making the battlefield resemble a plain covered with moving snakes.
Satyaki and Somadatta circle each other in chariots, both pierced with arrows and drenched in blood, shining like two red Kinsuka trees in spring.
